top_comments.author: @FerdinandTurla-b3v
top_comments.text: You can create algorithms that reduce the amount of processing power needed by aggregating questions into the most common used than have the answers ready which reduces overall costs, since, such requests do not have to utilize AI processes constantly. My guess is that well over 90% of all queries are never going to need AI processing on a real time basis and that legacy questions are going to be the majority of inputs that can be resolved using a database of prior answers.

top_reply.author: @Jack-vw5nm
top_reply.text: Nah any brief question that is concise enough to be answered like this is very low on inference anyway. This would also remove effects of temperature, the ability to AB test, the effect of custom instructions; memory; personality settings; chat context, and would be rewritten every time a model is updated.
